question: Set up the i4h workflow on this machine and tell me if any host requirements are missing.

question: Set up only the pinned Arena environment and verify its numerical assets.

expected_behavior: uses the public i4h-physics-simulation checkout pinned by third_party/setup.sh, including i4h-host
